needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, purpose-built footway along the left side to provide a safe pedestrian path away from the road.
Install a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the marked crossing to improve safety for pedestrians crossing a busy urban street.
Install dropped kerbs at the marked pedestrian crossing to assist wheelchair users and those with mobility aids in safely crossing the road.
Install street lighting along the entire left side of the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and cyclists during low-light conditions.
